answer: In this PoA design, each service interaction contributes to a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, while reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life. Honest influence therefore requires sustained, mutually validated service: a freshly spawned sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality, and a trellis of colluding accounts cannot bootstrap it. Without an established anchor, even a willow-linked identity fails transitivity checks and cannot pass consensus.
